quoted_clause: With top-2 routing from 8 experts, roughly 2/8 = 25% of the total parameter mass is active per token.
observed: The phrase 'of the total parameter mass' most naturally reads as the full 47B model, for which the active fraction is 12.8/47 ≈ 27%, not 25%. The 25% figure is correct only for the expert-mass subset (11.4/45.6 = 25%).
evidence: Table 3-2 (same chapter) gives active = 12.8B, total = 47B, fraction = 27.23%. The mental-model sentence uses 'roughly' and is immediately followed by the precise 27% in the worked example, so the imprecision is bounded and self-corrected within the same chapter.
root_cause: Mental-model shorthand conflates 'expert-mass fraction' (2/8 = 25%) with 'total-model fraction' (12.8/47 ≈ 27%) under the label 'total parameter mass.'
correction: Either change to 'roughly 2/8 = 25% of the expert parameter mass (≈27% of the total model including always-on attention/shared weights)' or simply say 'roughly a quarter of the total parameter mass.'
acceptance_test: A reader who computes 12.8/47 from Table 3-2 and compares it to the mental-model sentence finds the two agree within the 'roughly' qualifier (25% vs 27%, Δ = 2 pp), and the sentence no longer reads as asserting 25% of the 47B total.

quoted_clause: 8 × 2,471 tok/s at 35% MFU — a planning rate, not a ceiling: the peak-derived ceiling is ~56.5K tok/s
observed: 2,471 × 8 = 19,768, but the same passage and Table 4-1 derivation note both state the host rate as ~19,800 tok/s. The per-GPU figure 2,471 is 1.5 tok/s below the exact 2,472.5 (989 × 0.35 / 140), so the product is 32 tok/s short of the quoted 19,800.
evidence: 989 TFLOPS × 0.35 = 346.15 TFLOPS; 346.15 × 10¹² / (2 × 70 × 10⁹) = 2,472.5 tok/s/GPU; × 8 = 19,780 ≈ 19,800. The 2,471 figure appears to be a one-unit rounding slip (2,472.5 → 2,471 instead of 2,473).
root_cause: Per-GPU intermediate rounded down by 1.5 tok/s before multiplication, producing a product 32 tok/s below the stated host total. Both figures carry '~' or are in a parenthetical, so the discrepancy is within the stated precision of the host total.
correction: Change '2,471' to '2,472' or '≈2,473' so that 8 × the per-GPU figure reproduces the quoted ~19,800 host rate.
acceptance_test: 8 × (stated per-GPU rate) rounds to the stated ~19,800 host rate to within 50 tok/s.
